body:
Four owners accept source labels that overstate sodium stoichiometry, hydration, counterion identity or equivalence between a stock and its solute. The worker-10 source review supplies exact bounded corrections against campaign baseline `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Raw labels remain preserved as provenance; the changes do not authorize publication of each complete owner payload.

## Findings and primary evidence

### Na2-glyoxalate overstates sodium count

Owner: `data/ingredients/mapped/Na2-glyoxalate.yaml`. Proposal: `kg-glyoxylate-label`.

MediaDive ingredient 361 gives formula C2HNaO3 and molecular mass 96.017, consistent with CHEBI:91251 sodium glyoxylate. Its CAS-RN field is null. Correct the preferred label to sodium glyoxylate and preserve the literal Na2-glyoxalate as REJECTED_LABEL. Recipe concentration arithmetic is only internally consistent derived metadata, not independent experimental evidence. No disodium identity is established.

Primary references: [kg-md361](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/ingredient/361); [kg-medium_298b](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/medium/298b); [kg-CHEBI_91251](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?iri=http%3A%2F%2Fpurl.obolibrary.org%2Fobo%2FCHEBI_91251).

### Variable-water vanadate is not a monohydrate synonym

Owner: `data/ingredients/mapped/Navo3_X_H2o.yaml`. Proposal: `kg-vanadate-variable-hydrate`.

The Navo3_X_H2o owner has exact CHEBI:132095 monohydrate identity but accepts `NaVO3 x n H2O` as HYDRATE_FORM. MediaDive 700 preserves variable hydration, while ingredient 182 explicitly identifies the monohydrate. Retype the variable-n label as REJECTED_LABEL and retain its unresolved source-form requirement; leave the independently specific monohydrate case unchanged. Other inherited unqualified sodium vanadate/metavanadate hydrate aliases still require full-owner review.

Primary references: [kg-md700](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/ingredient/700); [kg-md182](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/ingredient/182); [kg-CHEBI_132095](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?iri=http%3A%2F%2Fpurl.obolibrary.org%2Fobo%2FCHEBI_132095).

### AQDS salt owner accepts the bare dianion name

Owner: `data/ingredients/mapped/AQDS.yaml`. Proposal: `kg-aqds-dianion-alias`.

The source salt is CAS 853-68-9, and MediaDive 521/PubChem CID 70070 support disodium C14H6Na2O8S2. The bare anthraquinone-2,6-disulfonate denotes the dianion represented by CHEBI:85112. Retype that bare alias as REJECTED_LABEL on the disodium owner; retain qualified Na2 wording and the supplied salt identity. This does not merge the salt with its active ion.

Primary references: [kg-md521](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/ingredient/521); [kg-pc_aqds](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/70070/property/InChI,InChIKey,IUPACName,MolecularFormula/JSON); [kg-CHEBI_85112](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?iri=http%3A%2F%2Fpurl.obolibrary.org%2Fobo%2FCHEBI_85112).

### Na2CO3-CO2 stock is not pure carbonate

Owner: `data/ingredients/mapped/Na2co3.yaml`. Proposal: `kg-carbonate-buffer-alias`.

The CHEBI:29377 sodium carbonate owner accepts `Na2CO3-CO2 buffer`. MediaDive ingredient 1685 and JCM 209 recipe context describe a 4% preparation supplied as 100 mL, not dry solute identity. Reject that stock alias on the pure-substance owner while preserving the raw source and unresolved CO2/preparation requirements. Do not assign this stock to another formulation merely because it contains carbonate. Inherited malformed NaCO3/Na CO aliases remain withheld; the separate Sodium_Carbonate_Solution owner still needs its own primary-source correction.

Primary references: [kg-md1685](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/ingredient/1685); [kg-mdJ209](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/medium/J209); [kg-CHEBI_29377](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?iri=http%3A%2F%2Fpurl.obolibrary.org%2Fobo%2FCHEBI_29377).

## Required follow-up and limits

Review the exact current owner bytes before applying the proposed deltas. If they have changed since the frozen baseline, reconcile those changes explicitly. Preserve every existing WITHHOLD, REJECTED_LABEL, source-context and downstream hold. Complete owner/role/publication assessment remains separate from these supported corrections. Structural LinkML validation of the proposal files does not establish scientific completeness.

Apply any accepted correction through the native guarded workflow with curation history, synchronized maintained surfaces, appropriate SSSOM updates and required validation. No owner merge, downstream rebuild, blanket alias activation or release approval is requested by this issue.

## Deduplication

No exact four-owner bundle was found in the live all-state issue snapshot. #251 concerns the historical hydrate-report blind spot and is closed; #459 is a wider hydrate cohort and #901 concerns asymmetric parent predicates. #1157 records five different source IDs. #718 comment 6717638594 already preserves a whole-owner carbonate hold and a different DSMZ 863 stock proposal; this JCM 209 alias finding is a bounded continuation, not proof that the whole carbonate owner is releasable. #1117 concerns carbonate monohydrate, and #1121 concerns carbonate used as a ceftazidime stabilizer. None establishes that these specific aliases are safe. Link this scoped follow-up to #718/#459 and do not close those umbrellas.

The checked GitHub issue snapshots and complete relevant comment payloads are retained under `context/kg-issue-*-live.json`; the all-state snapshot is `context/kg-issues-all-live.json`. The borax component dependency already belongs to #1168 and is excluded here.

title: Preserve chemical form and stock boundaries in glyoxylate, vanadate, AQDS and carbonate aliases
